title: Natural tensor cancellation in independent coefficient universes
statement: Let C be a site relatively essentially small in coefficient universe r, R and S commutative ring sheaves and α:R→S. For every S-module sheaf M and R-module sheaf N there is a natural isomorphism U(M tensor_S (S tensor_R N)) ≅ U(M) tensor_R N, with the displayed naturality equation for the recorded changeOfRingsHom and sheaf tensor constructions. No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the balanced sectionwise equivalence m tensor (s tensor n) ↦ (s m) tensor n and its inverse m tensor n ↦ m tensor (1 tensor n), using TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange. Tensor induction proves compatibility with restrictions and both variable maps. Restriction commutes with sheafification because the underlying abelian sheafification agrees; monoidal localization inverts the tensor of its unit. Compose the four natural sheafification comparisons, and use inverse naturality to establish the stated equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_changeOfRings_tensorCancellation_independentCoefficients (α : R ⟶ S) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{r} (𝓡 S))
        (N : SheafOfModules.{r} (𝓡 R)),
      (restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj
        ((monoidalCategory S).tensorObj M (changeOfRings α N)) ≅
      (monoidalCategory R).tensorObj ((restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj M) N,
      ∀ {M M' : SheafOfModules.{r} (𝓡 S)}
        {N N' : SheafOfModules.{r} (𝓡 R)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
        (restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).map
            ((monoidalCategory S).tensorHom f (changeOfRingsHom α N g)) ≫
          (e M' N').hom =
        (e M N).hom ≫
          (monoidalCategory R).tensorHom ((restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).map f) g
